clips.title: The story
paras: At the Stonewrought Dam, Chief Engineer Hinderweir needs a Crocolisk Tear to counter Dark Iron explosives.

Crocolisk Tears come from reptiles living in Loch Modan's waters. Chief Engineer Hinderweir found that their secretions have an unexpected use. Mixed with potent spider venom and resonant ogre minerals, a tear has the chemical properties needed to counter volatile Dark Iron demolition charges threatening the Stonewrought Dam.
